easy.def: To make a light ringing sound.

more.def: To make a light, ringing sound, as small bells do.
examples: The bells on the sleigh jingled.
The keys jingled in my pocket.
The coins jingled in her purse.

more.def: A short, catchy tune or song that is used in an ad.
examples: The ad had a catchy jingle.
I sang the jingle all day.
The jingle for the cereal stuck in my head.
